jobs.description:
Bioinformatics Specialist – AI Research & Data Analysis Compensation: $90–$110 per hour

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote | Independent Contractor

About the Opportunity We are seeking experienced bioinformatics and computational biology professionals to contribute to advanced AI research projects. The role focuses on designing scientific data-analysis challenges, developing reproducible computational workflows, and evaluating AI-generated analyses against rigorous scientific standards.
Candidates should have hands-on experience with biological datasets and be comfortable combining programming, statistical analysis, and scientific interpretation.
Key Responsibilities Develop multi-step bioinformatics problems involving genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, or other omics data.
Create precise scientific questions with objectively verifiable answers.
Identify suitable datasets from public repositories or other data sources you are legally authorized to use.
Perform reproducible analyses using Python or R, command-line utilities, and relevant scientific software.
Build Jupyter notebooks that validate analytical methods and reproduce expected results.
Assess AI-generated solutions for methodological accuracy, computational correctness, and biological interpretation.
Identify analytical errors, unsupported assumptions, and gaps in scientific reasoning.
Document results, limitations, and conclusions in clear scientific language.

Required Qualifications A Master's degree, PhD, or equivalent research experience in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Statistical Genetics, Quantitative Biology, or a closely related discipline.
Practical experience analyzing sequencing or omics data, from raw data processing through interpretation.
Proficiency in Python or R and the ability to produce reproducible analyses.
Familiarity with relevant tools such as Samtools, BCFtools, Bedtools, BWA, Bowtie2, BLAST, Biopython, pysam, DESeq2, edgeR, or Bioconductor.
Experience creating and running Jupyter notebooks.
Strong scientific writing, analytical reasoning, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications Expertise in a specialized area of bioinformatics, genomics, or computational biology.
Experience with single-cell RNA sequencing, bulk RNA-seq, WGS/WES, variant calling, metagenomics, or proteomics.
Experience using R, Python, statistical methods, or command-line bioinformatics workflows for research.
Access to datasets that you are legally authorized to use and share for research purposes.
Experience producing reproducible scientific analyses or reviewing computational research.

Independent contractor engagement
Flexible working schedule
Compensation of $90–$110 per hour, subject to the final terms of the engagement
Weekly payments through supported payment providers
Project duration may change according to research requirements and performance

The final evaluation, selection, contracting, and payment arrangements are handled by the organization responsible for the project. Submitting an application does not guarantee selection or engagement.

Where applicable and legally permitted, this information may be shared with the third-party organization responsible for evaluating applicants and managing the project.
Personal information will be handled in accordance with applicable data-protection requirements. Please review the relevant privacy information before submitting your application.

jobs.description:
Location:
Global, fully remote

Job Type:
Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule:
Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Mechanical Engineering Expert
to contribute to an AI training project involving engineering design, physical modeling, simulation, technical problem-solving, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks across structural, thermal, mechanical, and multiphysics domains. A representative task may require translating physical requirements into a computational model, generating the required geometry or mesh, applying materials and boundary conditions, running an engineering simulation, and determining whether the resulting artifact and analysis satisfy the applicable physical and design constraints.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents with python in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On

Solve and validate mechanical-engineering problems involving design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.
Translate physical systems and engineering requirements into analytical or computational models.
Create or modify geometry, meshes, materials, loads, contacts, constraints, and solver inputs.
Perform structural, thermal, dynamic, fatigue, buckling, vibration, or related analyses.
Use Python to automate model preparation, simulation, parameter sweeps, optimization, postprocessing, and verification.

Required Qualifications

An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; or
A BS in Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.
Strong understanding of applied mechanics and mechanical-engineering fundamentals.
Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions.
Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents.

Relevant tools may include CalculiX, Gmsh, Elmer, FEniCSx, CadQuery, OpenSCAD, OpenFOAM
, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter
, CAD or meshing APIs, finite-element libraries, optimization packages, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Process

Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
